solution:
With \(A(1,1,1)\), \(B(1,-1,2)\) and \(C(1,3,4)\): \(\overrightarrow{AB} = -2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC} = 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\).

\(\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC} = \hat{i}\left((-2)(3) - (1)(2)\right) - \hat{j}(0 - 0) + \hat{k}(0 - 0) = -8\hat{i}\), whose length is 8.

Area of \(\triangle ABC = \frac{1}{2} \times 8 = 4\) sq units. Hence (C).

solution:
The volume is the absolute value of the scalar triple product \([\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}]\), with \(\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j}\), \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) and \(\vec{c} = 3\hat{i} - \hat{k}\).

\([\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = \begin{vmatrix} 2 & -3 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = 2(-1 - 0) + 3(-1 + 3) + 0 = -2 + 6 = 4\).

So the volume is 4 cubic units. Hence (D).

solution:
With \(\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\): \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 2 + 6 + 2 = 10\) and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{6}\).

The projection of \(\vec{a}\) on \(\vec{b}\) is \(\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{10}{\sqrt{6}} = \frac{5\sqrt{6}}{3}\). Hence (C).
